title: Importing a leaf runs its package's __init__
why: acme/outsider/use.py imports acme.deep.leaf, and Python initializes every parent package on the way down — so acme/deep/__init__.py runs, and the guest list that names only acme/deep/** was not honoured. The import that broke the rule never mentions the file it broke it on.
unexpressible: import-linter and tach judge modules, not files: to them acme.deep and acme.deep.leaf are one subject, so a guest list that admits the leaf but not the package's own __init__ has no spelling in either config language.
